description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common setup routines such as logging initialization that other activities can inherit.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that extends FragmentActivity, providing common logging initialization and lifecycle management for derived activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the FragmentActivity's onCreate method to handle activity creation; currently only invokes superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the FragmentActivity's onStart method to initialize logging when activity becomes visible.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by creating a LogWrapper instance and attaching it to the Log class; logs a 'Ready' message.
